description: Input C:N below which the C:N leaching attenuation A_CN is zero.
C:N span above the minimum needed to reach the A_CN cap for cropland and natural non-cropland.
Steeper C:N span for the Other land-use class (rocky outcrops, urban edges, riparian, abandoned).
Maximum C:N leaching attenuation (forest woody-litter anchor).
IPCC EF5: fraction of leached NO3-N emitted as indirect N2O-N.
Atlantic (wet) NH3-N to indirect N2O-N factor EF4 (IPCC 2019 Table 11.3, wet climate, p. 11.26).
IPCC 2019 Table 11.3 NH3-N volatilisation fraction for synthetic fertiliser.
IPCC 2019 Table 11.3 NH3-N volatilisation fraction for organic N inputs.

SWAT fraction of porosity from which nitrate is excluded (theta_e, ANION_EXCL default): SWAT Input/Output File Documentation Version 2012, ch. 22 (.sol), p. 304; used in Neitsch et al. (2011) SWAT 2009 Theoretical Documentation eqs. 4:2.1.2-4:2.1.8.

IMAGE-GNM pre-exponential factor of the root-zone denitrification temperature effect f_K, multiplied by the root-zone residence time in years to give the dimensionless f_climate: Beusen et al. (2015) Geosci. Model Dev. 8:4045-4067, eqs. 12-13, p. 4052.
Activation energy of root-zone denitrification E_a,d (J mol-1): Beusen et al. (2015) Geosci. Model Dev. 8:4045-4067, eq. 13, p. 4052.
Molar gas constant R (J mol-1 K-1), as used in Beusen et al. (2015) eq. 13, p. 4052.

Depth over which IMAGE-GNM's total available water capacity is taken (m): the top 1 m (or less if thinner) of soil, Beusen et al. (2015) Geosci. Model Dev. 8:4045-4067, eq. 14, p. 4052. WHEP has no soil-thickness layer, so the full 1 m is used.

Upper bound of the root-zone residence time on cropland (yr): IMAGE-GNM supplement code n_soil_denitrification.py lines 377-378, min(1, Trz), which governs the p. 4052 sentence of Beusen et al. (2015) that reads as a floor of 1 yr on dry agricultural land.
Root-zone residence time where the excess water flow is zero (yr): IMAGE-GNM supplement code n_soil_denitrification.py, trzd(), lines 179-182; Beusen et al. (2015) eq. 14 is undefined there.

Upper bound of the IMAGE-GNM Arrhenius temperature effect f_K: IMAGE-GNM supplement code n_soil_denitrification.py, fr_Ndenitrification_temperature(), line 97, min(f_K, 1); Beusen et al. (2015) eq. 13 states no bound.

Correction coefficient f_cal of IMAGE-GNM surface runoff N, N_sro,rec = f_cal f_qsro N_inp: Beusen et al. (2015) Geosci. Model Dev. 8:4045-4067, eq. 9, p. 4052 (C_sro,N of Table 3, p. 4056); IMAGE-GNM supplement code parameters_history_100.ini line 210 (N_calibration_factor).

Offset a of the IMAGE-GNM erosion slope factor a + b / (1 + exp(c - d S / 1000)), S the median slope in m/km: IMAGE-GNM supplement code n_erosion.py line 50 (soil loss after Cerdan et al. 2010, Beusen et al. 2015 p. 4052).
Range b of the IMAGE-GNM erosion slope factor a + b / (1 + exp(c - d S / 1000)): IMAGE-GNM supplement code n_erosion.py line 50.
Intercept c of the IMAGE-GNM erosion slope factor a + b / (1 + exp(c - d S / 1000)): IMAGE-GNM supplement code n_erosion.py line 50.
Rate d of the IMAGE-GNM erosion slope factor a + b / (1 + exp(c - d S / 1000)), with S / 1000 the slope in m/m: IMAGE-GNM supplement code n_erosion.py line 50.
